reviews.t: It does everything it says it would!
reviews.x: Minimal shedding Hair looks healthy, feels soft and smooth Hair smells wonderful! I will continue to use and recommend this product.

I recently purchased this product and could not have been more pleased. I have 4c hair and it helps keep my ends moisturized. I do notice a little build up if I use too many products with it...so KIS (keep it simple). Once I received such great results I decided to use on my daughter's mixed 4a hair..Her hair loves it as well.

Nothing has ever made my 3B curls feel so soft and durable. It must be packed with Omega 3s. If you suffer from tangles, frizz and breakage, then you need this stuff. I only use two pumps per day (one for each side), and it's like hair medicine.

This is my holy grail leave in. It has great slip, even on dry hair and sinks in to my strands without feeling heavy. It moisturizes deeply and leaves my hair feeling great. It doesn't leave a residue behind and I can use it day after day without needing to wash it due to buildup. I got mine for 15 at target, and while the bottle doesn't look big for the price- I've used less than half in about 3 weeks. I love it so much I bought a second for my mom today without asking her if she needs it. She
I'm forever buying this for my beard. It softens a coarse type hair. I use it whenever I comb my beard.

I’ve been purchasing this product from Target. This is my 3rd bottle and I use it everyday. I can no longer find it at Target or Walmart; only online. I just needed something that moisturized and could leave in w/o using mousse or hairspray that would damage my hair because it was already dried out and Thinning. As with any product some might work better for one than for the other. You’ll never know until you try it.

reviews.t: Didn’t know low poo makes such a difference
reviews.x: No shedding.  Curl pattern is looking great. Not heavy. I did some research about why products wouldn’t ‘take’ and would flake off. I realized I had low porosity and this product was recommended on a curly hair site. Works great!
I really like this leave in and it really does make your hair soft!

I love Deep Hydration Softening Milk. It smells great and keeps my hair moisturized. The only thing keeping me from giving it five stars is the packaging. You can never really use all of the product which is annoying because it is on the pricier side of hair products. I still keep a bottle on hand though because it works so well.

reviews.t: Instant moisture to my thirsty 4C coils
reviews.x: This product is the best of all the products I've used. Gave instant moisture to my crunchy spongy 4C coils. Light weight and sweet fragrance. Not too pricy too!!. I'm sticking with this one.

My review has changed. It's difficult to keep my natural 4C hair moisturize. I thought I had finally found the perfect hair product. Well...not so. My con is, it leaves a white residue on my hair. I didn't see it at first, but after using it for a while, I definitely notice the build-up. Also my hair becomes stiff after a couple uses. Guess it's back to the drawing board for me.

It’s like a pomade in case you’re wondering... it may way down your hair if you wear it straight... however, I wear my hair curly ( natural) or blown straight  ( mostly if I’m going to an event etc...) it’s easier to keep natural ... this moisturizer PREVENTS BREAKAGE; therefore, hair is allowed to grow.

I love love this product! My very fine black hair (? 4C)  loves it. My hair has more elasticity and looks more healthy than ever before. I even love the tingle I feel  on the scalp after I use this product. So very refreshing and nourishing!

I needed a moisture cream to use after a leave in that did not have butters, coconut oil and boy that's nearly impossible nowadays.  This however was a miracle to find. It defines and soaks into the hair, leaves it dark and soft. The best part is it's all natural and works for all my kids and my husband's hair. We have textures ranging from 3b to 4b. Please keep this product always! I can use it everyday with no buildup. It's the best moisture cream I've found.

I have been transitioning for a couple of years to natural hair. In the beginning this product was perfect on my hair. Now that I’m all natural and my hair is muck much longer I didn’t get the same affect I got in the beginning of my journey. My texture has completely changed. Try it you might like it. I swore by it, but now I’m completely gray and it doesn’t work as well now. It’s worth a try

I really like this product.  First, found in a department store and because of Covid ordered through Amazon.  It is expensive and I go through quite a bit because I have allot of hair.  I will see if I can find something as enriching for my hair that is less expensive.  Purchasing this on a regular can break the personal products budget.

I went on a detangler shopping spree because I was so frustrated with knots and tangles after shampooing and conditioning. I finally made my way to the milk this week.  Answered prayer. I said “I don’t know what Courtney put in here, but IT IS THE TRUTH.” My hair responded instantly.  Buy a bottle ladies - it’s a gift.

Love this product. I think I'm staying with this specific line, it leaves my hair soft, my curls are defined & shinny hair. Most importntly for me my hair is not crunchy nor oily or wet loo (which I hate). I do recommend it to all my friends & family members.

It really does soften my type 4c tightly curled hair and makes it manageable.  It doesn't provide sheen but I'll take the moisture aspect vs sheen.  It doesn't weigh your hair down or make it goopy like butter creams.  Will buy more.
My hair is very dry and tried many other products before this and it has been a blessing. This is the most moisturizing daily hair treatment found thus far

reviews.t: Unfortunately, this product did not work well for my hair.
reviews.x: This product did not work well for me. I returned it. It just shows that every product is not for every hair type.
Feels fantastic! I will purchase entire set. Tysm

My lady and I love this product. Our grandbaby has type 4c hair and it requires constant attention. The name choice has made her hair manageable, soft and it looks and feels more hydrated. We've tried probably a dozen other products but this one seems to fit our needs. Night and day difference from any other product we've used. I highly recommend this for dryer less manageable hair.

Works great to soften your hair while keeping curls looking great. I have bought this 5 times, so obviously I love it. 4 stars instead of 5 just because the bottle is so small. As someone who tries to reduce personal plastic purchases, I really hate this many plastic bottles. I wish I could buy it in larger quantities. I still love it though and am buying another.

reviews.t: It doesn’t change the hair texture it makes it easy to work on the most curliest tangled hair
reviews.x: My 2yr old has very curly thick hair ...whether I use it straight out the shower or during the afternoon it makes her hair manageable on instant you read me instant ...no crying or ouching made by her ...I recommend this product especially for children and it doesn’t take the hair out it helps grows it ....I love it wish I created it!

claims.text: Most reviewers say it moisturizes deeply and leaves hair soft and smooth.
Many reviewers praise the scent and lightweight feel without heaviness or residue.
Several reviewers report it works well for curly and coily hair types, including 4C, 3B, and mixed textures.
A few reviewers mention build-up or white residue, especially with overuse or long-term use.
Some reviewers note packaging issues or difficulty using all the product, and one mentions it stopped working as well as hair changed.
